angleRead.name: Lila Mezran
angleRead.text: Standing on the corner of Webster and 7th, watching the lunch crowd move between the pharmacy and the noodle shops, I keep thinking about the numbers that don't show up in a ledger. Chinatown is carrying 140 sick residents this cycle — the most of any neighborhood — and yet when I look at the hospital records, not one of them is named. The six people on the record are from Rockridge, Lake Merritt, Jack London. The people here, the ones who make up that 140, they're just numbers in a column. Marisio Curazo coordinates elder care in this neighborhood — she sees the human cost every day. Omarion Farah drives his cab through these streets, picking up passengers who mention a spouse who can't get
